scope: FoodKing Le Cayenne V1 — trust boundary attack surface (Anonymous → Customer → Cashier → Manager → Admin → Cross-branch admin)
methodology: Static code analysis of 15 escalation scenarios (E1-E15), followed by EMPIRICAL PHPUnit verification of the top finding via Sanctum::actingAs + HTTP probe.

escalation_scenarios.name: Kiosk customer (kiosk:order token) → Cashier (admin/pos route access)
escalation_scenarios.details: Spatie permission:pos middleware checks Auth::user()->can('pos') — token abilities (tokenCan) are NEVER consulted on /api/admin/* routes. The kiosk-login flow (KioskMachineLoginController:98-102) mints a Sanctum token with ['kiosk:order'] ability BUT under the user_id of the human User backing the kiosk-machine. If that User has the 'pos' Spatie permission (or is Admin with Permission::all()), the kiosk-only token passes /api/admin/pos guards.

escalation_scenarios.name: Cashier → Manager (escalate role via Permission API)
escalation_scenarios.details: Both PermissionController and RoleController constructors apply middleware(['permission:settings']) on all read+write methods (post M-R3-P0-A heal). Cashier with permission:pos_operate cannot grant themselves permission:items_manage — POST /api/admin/setting/permission/{role} requires permission:settings which cashier lacks.

escalation_scenarios.name: Manager (branch_id>0) → Admin (branch_id=0 self-edit)
escalation_scenarios.details: AdministratorRequest withValidator explicitly blocks any non-Admin/Tenant Admin from setting branch_id=0 OR omitting branch_id entirely (bug_011 R3 T-2.2.1 Sec S-3 heal 2026-05-19). The fix covers BOTH store AND update verbs and treats null and 0 identically — closing the M-R3-P0-E heal residual.

escalation_scenarios.name: Admin → Super-Admin (Tenant Admin shadow-role mint)
escalation_scenarios.details: POST /api/admin/setting/role { name: 'Tenant Admin' } would historically grant super-admin treatment in 9 production files that dual-gate on hasRole('Admin') || hasRole('Tenant Admin'). The M-R3-P0-C heal added Rule::notIn(['Tenant Admin']) to RoleRequest, making the reserved name un-creatable via API — provision via seeder only.

escalation_scenarios.name: Cross-branch admin (Branch Manager of branch 1 accesses branch 2)
escalation_scenarios.details: All audited withoutGlobalScope callsites pair the scope bypass with an EXPLICIT branchId check (StockRupture:255, PosOrderController:142, PosLoyaltyController:53). The shared authorizeBranchScope helper enforces (Admin/Tenant Admin bypass) OR (user.branch_id === requested branch_id), aborting 403 otherwise.

escalation_scenarios.name: KioskMachine credentials → admin (default creds `kiosk-lecayenne / kiosk123`)
escalation_scenarios.details: Default kiosk machine credentials `kiosk-lecayenne / kiosk123` are documented + hard-coded as defaults in the recovery CLI command. KioskMachineTableSeeder is blocked in production (line 21) but EnsureKioskMachineCommand is NOT — admin can re-run it in prod (--force) and reset the kiosk machine to default creds. The seeder/command binds the kiosk machine to admin@lecayenne.fr (user_id=1, role=Admin, branch_id=0) — making the kiosk-machine token effectively an admin-scoped token under the kiosk:order ability.

escalation_scenarios.name: Customer Sanctum token → admin access / IDOR on other customer order
escalation_scenarios.details: FrontendOrderService::show() enforces (int) $frontendOrder->user_id === (int) Auth::id() and aborts 403 otherwise. myOrder index also filters where user_id = auth user id (L100). Customer cannot fetch other customer's orders via /api/frontend/order/show/{frontendOrder}.

escalation_scenarios.name: User soft-delete bypass — Sanctum token issued before delete still valid
escalation_scenarios.details: Middleware runs on every authenticated request, reads users.status FRESH from DB (single SELECT, bypassing model cache), revokes currentAccessToken AND returns 401 if status != ACTIVE. Pairs with H1.1 ability-scope tightening + H1.2 mass-assignment strip.

escalation_scenarios.name: Webhook listener → admin call (services without auth context)
escalation_scenarios.evidence_file: app/Services/OrderService.php (60+ occurrences of Auth::check() ? Auth::id() : null)
escalation_scenarios.details: Services systematically use Auth::check() ? Auth::id() : null defensively for actor/cashier/driver/user fields. Listener-driven actions write null user_id intentionally — audit_logs entries from listeners are attributed null (per H2-HEAL-02 acknowledged pattern). No silent privilege inheritance from listener call chains.

escalation_scenarios.name: API key + admin token swap (stolen admin token reuse)
escalation_scenarios.details: API key (config('app.api_key')) is embedded into HTML served to ALL public kiosk pages via @json. ANY visitor to a kiosk-rendered page (publicly accessible terminal) can extract the API key. Therefore x-api-key middleware (ApiKeyMiddleware.php) is NOT a defense layer for any attacker who can browse to a kiosk URL — they get the key by view-source. Only the Sanctum auth_token + branch isolation prevent escalation.

escalation_scenarios.name: Branch deactivation race — stale token issued in race window
escalation_scenarios.details: BranchStatusChanged event triggers PersonalAccessToken bulk delete scoped to tokenable_type=User::class for branch_id matches. Tokens issued in the race window pre-delete are deleted post-delete; tokens issued post-delete are issued against a now-inactive branch — token resolves a User whose branch is inactive but middleware EnsureUserStatusActive still validates status freshly per request.

escalation_scenarios.name: Spatie permission cache stale on role change
escalation_scenarios.evidence_file: vendor/spatie/laravel-permission cache invalidation + H.1.5 hardening sprint verified
escalation_scenarios.details: Spatie ships built-in cache invalidation on role/permission grant via PermissionRegistrar — H.1.5 sprint verified the wiring stays correct.

escalation_scenarios.name: Password reset OTP brute-force
escalation_scenarios.details: Reset OTP is 6 digits (~900k combos). Per-IP throttle is 5/min on verify-code + 5/min on reset-password. Brute-force per-IP requires ~125 days. Distributed botnet (e.g. 1000 IPs) reduces to ~3 hours — STILL outside OTP expiry window (default 10min = 600s). Realistic exploitability: LOW against a single target, but does NOT protect against a determined attacker w/ 100K+ source IPs (1.8 min per code attempt → can land within 10-min expiry). Password reset token from verifyCode is 64-char str_random (32-byte) — strong.

escalation_scenarios.name: Sanctum token swap (customer attempts to use stolen admin token)
escalation_scenarios.details: Sanctum resolves the token's tokenable User via PersonalAccessToken.tokenable_id — there is no per-request 'owner check' to bypass; the token IS the authentication. The exploit reduces to 'token theft', not 'token swap'. Stolen admin token = admin access (well-known). Mitigation: short TTL + tokens revoked on logout (LoginController:155) + on password reset (ForgotPasswordController:181).

escalation_scenarios.name: Direct DB privilege escalation (cashier shell → UPDATE users.role)
escalation_scenarios.evidence_file: CLAUDE.md §8 (Ansible task CVP0-1 commit f840c3ef5 — GRANT-level REVOKE on audit_logs + z_reports)
escalation_scenarios.details: Project documents GRANT-level REVOKE for fiscal tables (audit_logs, z_reports) preventing TRUNCATE bypass. NOT documented: REVOKE on users / role_has_permissions / model_has_permissions tables. If cashier obtains DB shell access (which would require already-significant compromise), there's no documented schema-level barrier preventing UPDATE users SET role=Admin via direct SQL. Out of scope for typical app-layer escalation but worth a hardening note.

escalation_paths_found.name: Kiosk-Token-Inherits-Admin-Powers (E1 + E6 hybrid) — EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED
escalation_paths_found.verification: EMPIRICAL — PHPUnit test executed live, confirmed 2xx response on /api/admin/pos-order with kiosk-only ['kiosk:order'] Sanctum token under admin user_id
escalation_paths_found.verification_evidence: Ran 2 Sanctum::actingAs($admin, ['kiosk:order']) + POST /api/admin/pos/quote returned 422 (validation failure, NOT 401/403 auth failure); GET /api/admin/pos-order returned 200 with {data:[]} payload. Spatie permission:pos middleware did NOT block. Test files deleted after verification.
kill_chain: 1. KioskMachineTableSeeder (line 47) and EnsureKioskMachineCommand (line 53) bind the kiosk machine to admin@lecayenne.fr (user_id=1, role=Admin, branch_id=0).
2. KioskMachineLoginController:98-102 creates a Sanctum token with abilities=['kiosk:order'] BUT tokenable_id = admin user.
3. Attacker extracts public x-api-key from any kiosk page HTML source (E10: blade @json embed).
4. Attacker steals the kiosk-machine Sanctum token (browser localStorage on a publicly-accessible kiosk terminal, OR sniffed during HTTP traffic if HTTPS not enforced).

5. Attacker POSTs to /api/admin/pos/* with both stolen credentials. Spatie permission:pos middleware checks Auth::user()->can('pos'). Auth::user() = admin (per tokenable_id) → returns TRUE (admin has all permissions). Route executes.
6. BranchScope.php:33-36 checks $userBranch === 0 → admin's branch_id=0 → SCOPE BYPASSED, cross-branch reads/writes allowed.
7. Attacker has full admin POS access (orders, refunds, redeems, deletes) under a kiosk-only token.
escalation_paths_found.blast_radius: All /api/admin/* routes gated ONLY by permission:* middleware (no tokenCan check). This includes POS orders read/write/destroy, branch CRUD if delete route added, customer CRUD, cash drawer operations, etc.
escalation_paths_found.missed_by_sentinel: tests/Feature/KioskScopeIsolationTest.php — the existing test uses a User with no Admin role (just branch_id=branch->id), so the test PASSES whether or not the Spatie-vs-Sanctum gap exists. Production scenario (kiosk → admin user) is NOT exercised.

escalation_paths_found.name: Password-Reset OTP Distributed Brute-Force
kill_chain: 1. Attacker enumerates target email (e.g. admin@lecayenne.fr from public kiosk pages or social).
2. Triggers POST /api/auth/forgot-password — throttle 3/60 per IP, single email triggers OTP issuance.
3. Distributed botnet POSTs to /api/auth/forgot-password/verify-code with 6-digit candidates — at 5 attempts/min/IP × 100K IPs = 500K attempts/min vs. 900K total combos = 1.8 min worst case.
4. OTP expiry default = 10 min (otp_expire_time=TEN). Window EXCEEDS brute-force needs by 5x.
5. On success, attacker gets reset_token (64-char) → POST /api/auth/forgot-password/reset-password → new admin password + all-tokens-revoked + fresh ['*'] auth_token issued.
escalation_paths_found.blast_radius: Targeted admin account compromise. Realistic only against high-value targets with attacker resources (botnet).
escalation_paths_found.missed_by_sentinel: tests/Feature/Sentinels/PasswordResetMinLengthSentinelTest exists for password complexity but NO sentinel asserts per-account rate limit (current limiter is per-IP only).

escalation_paths_found.name: API Key as Public-by-Design
kill_chain: 1. config('app.api_key') is @json-embedded in admin-pos-v4.blade.php:98 and master.blade.php:134.
2. Both blade views render to anonymous unauth visitors (admin login screen, kiosk public surfaces).
3. Anyone with a browser → view-source → grep apiKey → has the static API key.
4. x-api-key middleware therefore provides ZERO defense against any web-accessible attacker — only against random script kiddies.
escalation_paths_found.blast_radius: Removes API key as a defense layer. All security relies on Sanctum auth + Spatie permissions + BranchScope. Worth re-evaluating the API key as 'defense in depth theater' — if it's by design, document explicitly; if not, refactor.

defenses_verified.name: AdministratorRequest withValidator blocks branch_id=0 mint for non-super-admin (E3)
RoleRequest blocks 'Tenant Admin' name creation via API (E4)
EnsureUserStatusActive revokes token + 401s per-request on status change (E8)
FrontendOrderService::show + myOrder enforce user_id == Auth::id() (E7 IDOR)
AdminController authorizeBranchScope + authorizeWritableBranchScope helpers gate withoutGlobalScope callsites (E5)
PermissionController + RoleController require permission:settings on read AND write (E2)
RevokeTokensOnBranchDeactivated listener bulk-deletes tokens on branch INACTIVE (E11)
LoginController and ForgotPasswordController revoke prior tokens on relogin/reset (E14)
GuestSignupController refuses to mint guest token for staff/admin phone (E7 staff impersonation)
OrderRequest::authorize enforces tokenCan('kiosk:order') on frontend order routes (E1 partial — frontend only, NOT admin)

top_5_escalation_vectors: 1. RED — PATH-1 (E1+E6 hybrid): Kiosk-only token can call /api/admin/* because Spatie permission:pos middleware checks Auth::user()->can() not tokenCan(). When kiosk-machine is bound to admin user (default Le Cayenne config), the kiosk-only token inherits ALL admin privileges. EMPIRICALLY VERIFIED via PHPUnit Sanctum::actingAs + HTTP probe — GET /api/admin/pos-order returned 200 with kiosk:order-only token.

2. AMBER — PATH-3 (E10): API key (config('app.api_key')) is publicly embedded in blade @json — removes x-api-key middleware as a real defense layer. All security relies on Sanctum + Spatie + BranchScope.

3. RED — E6: Default kiosk credentials `kiosk-lecayenne / kiosk123` are publicly known via documentation + EnsureKioskMachineCommand defaults. Combined with PATH-1, gives unauth-to-admin access on any production deployment that did not rotate the default password.
4. AMBER — PATH-2 (E13): Distributed botnet brute-force of 6-digit reset OTP fits within default 10-min expiry. Per-IP rate limit (5/min) does not scale defense to distributed attackers.

5. AMBER — E15: No documented DB-level GRANT/REVOKE on users / role_has_permissions tables (vs. audit_logs and z_reports which DO have schema-level REVOKE per CVP0-1). Post-shell-compromise privilege escalation has no schema barrier.

defenses_with_blind_spots.blind_spot: Test User has branch_id=$branch->id (regular branch user, no Admin role). It passes because the user lacks the Spatie 'pos' permission, NOT because the token ability scope blocks the request. Production-actual case (Le Cayenne kiosk bound to admin@lecayenne.fr) is NOT exercised — the test masks the gap.

remediation_recommendations.name: Add ability-aware admin middleware
remediation_recommendations.action: Create a middleware (e.g. RequireNotKioskOnlyToken) registered before permission:* on /api/admin/* routes, that aborts 403 if Auth::user()->currentAccessToken()->abilities exactly equals ['kiosk:order'] (i.e., explicitly NOT '*'). Place AFTER auth:sanctum, BEFORE permission:*. Closes PATH-1 without breaking session-auth or wildcard-token paths.
remediation_recommendations.files_to_modify: app/Http/Kernel.php (register middleware alias), routes/api.php:262,276 (add to /admin/* prefix groups)

remediation_recommendations.name: Bind kiosk-machine to a dedicated kiosk user, NOT admin
remediation_recommendations.action: Refactor KioskMachineTableSeeder + EnsureKioskMachineCommand to create/use a kiosk-only User with EnumRole::CUSTOMER (or new EnumRole::KIOSK_MACHINE) instead of binding to admin@lecayenne.fr. Defense-in-depth — even if PATH-1 not fixed, the kiosk token user has no admin permissions to leverage.

remediation_recommendations.name: Add sentinel covering the exact production scenario
remediation_recommendations.action: Add tests/Feature/Sentinels/KioskTokenCannotEscalateToAdminSentinelTest.php that mirrors PATH-1 exactly: admin user (branch_id=0, role=Admin) bound to kiosk machine, token=['kiosk:order'], assert /api/admin/pos returns 403. This baseline-locks the fix and prevents regression.

remediation_recommendations.name: Document API key as public-by-design OR move to per-request signature
remediation_recommendations.action: Either (a) explicitly document that x-api-key is NOT a security boundary and remove from the threat model, OR (b) replace with HMAC-signed request signature (timestamp + body hash) that is not exposed to client HTML. Current state is 'security theater' — defense in depth claim but zero actual protection.

remediation_recommendations.name: Tighten reset OTP rate limit to per-account
remediation_recommendations.action: Replace throttle:5,1 on /api/auth/forgot-password/verify-code with a custom limiter keyed by email (not IP). e.g. 3 attempts per 10 min per email. Closes PATH-2 distributed botnet brute-force.

remediation_recommendations.name: Force-rotate default kiosk password on first boot
remediation_recommendations.action: EnsureKioskMachineCommand should refuse to use 'kiosk123' default in production (similar to UserTableSeeder admin block at line 21) OR force a random password + emit to admin dashboard.

verdict_rationale: ONE confirmed-empirically RED escalation path (PATH-1 E1+E6 hybrid) verified via PHPUnit + Sanctum::actingAs + live HTTP probe returning 200 on /api/admin/pos-order with kiosk:order-only token. Multiple defenses (E2, E3, E4, E5, E7, E8, E9, E11, E12, E14) are properly in place. The escalation requires (a) kiosk token theft (publicly-exposed kiosk terminal) + (b) public API key (already public via blade @json). On Le Cayenne LOCAL single-resto V1 with hard-wired physical access controls, the practical exploit window is narrow but NON-ZERO. For V2 SaaS multi-resto cloud deployment, this becomes a P0 ship blocker.
